title: The frozen extraction queue
description: The manifest of what extraction was ASKED to produce, frozen before wave 2 runs. It is the only record of that ask: the index and the records on disk can only show what exists, so a row that produced no file, and a file no row asked for, are both invisible without it. Declared as a schema because the queue is a SIBLING WAVE's file — without one, a run handed the wrong document reconciled a correct corpus against an empty manifest and blamed the artifact's author for every record in it.

item_id.description: The source id extraction was asked to produce a record for. The record's FILENAME is derived from it by `record_filename`, never written out.
